## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o1
The OpenAI o1 model, released by OpenAI on 2024-12-17, is a premium, non-open-source language model designed to handle complex tasks. Its architecture is tailored for advanced natural language processing, with a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens. The model's knowledge cutoff is 2023-10, ensuring it has a robust understanding of information up to that point. With capabilities including text processing, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, system prompts, and extended thinking, OpenAI o1 is a powerful tool for developers.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
OpenAI o1 demonstrates exceptional performance across various benchmarks, including MMLU (92.3), HumanEval (94.4), LMSYS Arena ELO (1330), and GSM8K (99.5). Its primary strengths lie in complex reasoning, math, science, coding, research, PhD-level problems, legal analysis, and financial modeling. However, it is not suitable for simple tasks, high-volume applications, low-latency requirements, vision tasks, or budget-conscious projects. The model's pricing structure includes input costs of $15.0 per 1M tokens, output costs of $60.0 per 1M tokens, and discounted rates for cached input and batch input at $7.5 per 1M tokens.
